name: Marsupilami
s: Disney's version of Marsupilami first appeared on television in Raw Toonage in 1992, and was then spun off into his own eponymous show on the NBC network. Marsupilami is a fast talking marsupial who is like half-cheetah/half-monkey with a long tail. paragraphs.text: Marsupilami is a half-hour American animated television segment series that first appeared on television as short series that aired in the 1992 program Raw Toonage, and was then spun off into his own eponymous show on CBS for the 1993 season. The show was based on the character from the popular comic book by Belgian artist André Franquin et al.
There were three segments in the half-hour show — Marsupilami, Sebastian, and Shnookums and Meat.
